description:
Seolhwa, who is not possessed by a spirit, carefully monitors the actions and movements of her clients through their social media, using her exceptional acting skills to pose as a fortune teller. 

One day, a man named Shinwoo, who is haunted by a ghost, comes to see her. Not only is the ghost attached to him unusual, but Shinwoo's appearance is extraordinary as well! 

To help Shinwoo, who fits her ideal type perfectly, Seolhwa embarks on a mission to chase the ghost away...!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/taoist_fairy), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/taoist_fairy), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000073832), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13304096), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250795)
